messages:
maya: Just finished Luminex interview. Recording + raw transcript in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/luminex. Need: redlined transcript, public-safe quote, embargo date, one 30s hero clip + 3 webinar soundbites, EN/DE captions, and lead-routing.

mina: Nice. They said 'we cut inference spend by half' and mentioned a couple of p95 numbers. Legal will want the public copy softened.

julian: Ops - can we set lead tag `luminex-benchmark` and route hot demos to Mina? Also add UTMs for campaign tracking.

legal-bot: Automated check: NDA present; release form required. Public copy must avoid raw telemetry (p95/p99), internal IDs, and hostnames. Recommend phrasing: "reduced inference costs by ~50%" or "substantially reduced inference costs and improved latency." If customer insists on exact numbers, require signed telemetry addendum. Final legal sign-off contingent on redlined transcript attached to the release.

maya: I'll draft two public-safe quote options and send to the customer for quick approval (48h). Also asking for logo permission.

mina: For routing: set utm_campaign=luminex_launch, utm_source=twitter, utm_medium=social and rule: if lead_tag==luminex-benchmark -> assign to Mina (mina@redwood.ai) with priority high-touch.

julian: Will add pixel and workflow in HubSpot. Example landing link: https://redwood.ai/luminex?utm_campaign=luminex_launch&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social

maya: Deliverables ETA: hero_30s.mp4 + 3x15s clips + EN/DE captions by EOD tomorrow. I'll upload clips to Drive and tag them.

legal-bot: Please attach the redlined transcript to the release form. Legal will flip green after signed public quote + transcript.

mina: Also want a webinar slot the week after publish for a deeper benchmark walkthrough. Tentative webinar date: 2026-05-20.

maya: Proposed embargo: 2026-05-06 09:00 PT. Does that work for product/webinar?

mina: Works for webinar prep. I'll coordinate demo calendar.

julian: Pixel + HubSpot flow staged. Routing test passed. Will move to live at embargo time.

maya: Sent two public quote options to Luminex. Asking for approval within 48 hours.

luminex-reply-bot (via email): Customer approved paraphrased public quote: "reduced inference costs by ~50%" and granted logo usage. Signed release uploaded.

legal-bot: Received signed release. Please attach redlined transcript for final review.

maya: Redlined transcript uploaded to Drive and attached to the release form.

legal-bot: Final review complete  all clear. No PII or internal IDs in public copy. Embargo cleared.

julian: Scheduling landing page publish and social queue for 2026-05-06 09:00 PT. HubSpot rules and pixel will go live then.

mina: I'll prepare outreach templates and stand by for hot-lead alerts at launch. Thanks team :rocket:
